references.title: Kew Tree of Life Explorer, release 4.0 (April 2026)
authors: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew and collaborators

references.title: A Comprehensive Phylogenomic Platform for Exploring the Angiosperm Tree of Life

dataset.evidence: Kew release 4.0 phylogenomic species-tree topology. These are the authors’ supplied species, family and order trees, not an inferred classification hierarchy. No source branch lengths are supplied.
dataset.limitations: Sampling is incomplete and this is one inferred hypothesis. Gymnosperm outgroups are included. Numeric internal labels are retained without interpreting their support type. Drawing depth has no time or evolutionary-distance meaning.
dataset.changes: Source bytes unchanged. Opening creates explicit collapsed overview groups; later selection, reduction and artwork are recorded separately.
dataset.rootEvidence: Kew release 4.0 notes specify rooting using gymnosperm outgroups; the supplied serialization root is retained. https://sftp.kew.org/pub/paftol/releases/4.0/kew_tree_of_life_release_notes_4.0.txt
dataset.name: Flowering plants · orders + outgroups

transformations: Selected source tip identities; omitted memberships retained.
Nonmetric layouts authored in browser; no dating or relationship inference.

root.explanation: Kew release 4.0 notes specify rooting using gymnosperm outgroups; the supplied serialization root is retained. https://sftp.kew.org/pub/paftol/releases/4.0/kew_tree_of_life_release_notes_4.0.txt
